_comment: REFERENCE COPY. Publish this at docs/versions.json in each game repo, which GitHub Pages serves at https://dwarvenengineering.com/<repo-name>/versions.json. Delete the _comment keys. After the first release, scripts/update-manifest.mjs rewrites this file for you.
title: Dwarven Depths

latest._comment_mandatory: Advisory only. The game tells the player the update matters; it never locks them out of playing.
latest._comment_notes: One string per bullet. These render in the game's update panel AND in the devlog on the website.
notes: Cave-ins now propagate through unsupported ceilings.
Fixed the audio crackle on the Anbernic build at low battery.
latest._comment_builds: Keys must match what update_checker.gd looks for: windows, linux-arm64, linux, macos. A platform with no entry gets the notice but no in-game download.

windows._comment_sha: Required. The game refuses to run an installer whose hash does not match.

_comment_history: Previous releases, newest first. Only version/released/notes are kept — old download links are left to the GitHub Releases page.
